headline: Editorial pass over 424 XSIAM pages: 276 gain search descriptions, two lose reference detail
summary_md:
- **276 pages** gained a `description` frontmatter block and 73 more had theirs rewritten, a metadata pass covering most of the Cortex XSIAM book.
- Headings and prose were rewritten to name **Cortex XSIAM** explicitly, and the multi-tenant child tenant pages moved from Incidents and Alerts to **Cases and Issues**.
- Two pages lost reference detail: the node icons table in the causality icons key, and the step-by-step rule criteria in Set up case scoring.
- Twelve stub section pages gained child page indexes, and three pages had collapsible sections flattened into ordinary headings.
- No page was added, removed or renamed; nine navigation titles changed, but every path stayed put.

highlights.title: The causality icons key lost its node icons table
highlights.detail: Twenty-three lines of node icon rows were deleted, leaving the section heading and its one-line introduction with nothing beneath them.

highlights.title: Set up case scoring dropped its step-by-step rule criteria
highlights.detail: The substeps covering rule name, score, base rule, the apply-to-first-issue-only option and filter selection were replaced by the worked example alone.

highlights.title: Child tenant management now says Cases and Issues, not Incidents and Alerts
highlights.detail: Across three multi-tenant pages the parent tenant's viewable page list and its configurable actions were renamed, including Starred Issue Policies and Issue Exclusions.

highlights.title: 276 pages gained a search description
highlights.detail: Pages that carried no frontmatter description now have one, and 73 existing descriptions were rewritten to name the product and the task.

highlights.title: Device control was restructured and rebranded
highlights.detail: The page gained capabilities, prerequisites and limitations headings, and the Cortex XDR references in its Bluetooth limitation rows became Cortex XSIAM.

highlights.title: Twelve stub section pages gained child page indexes
highlights.detail: Cloud Identity Security, Endpoint DLP and Remote repository management were one-line stubs that now list the pages beneath them.

items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: The node icons table was removed; the heading and its introduction now stand alone.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/customize-c: The instructions for defining rule criteria were cut down to the example values, and the SmartScore section was retitled.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/multi-tenan: Incidents and Alerts became Cases and Issues, and the configurable actions are now Starred Issue Policies and Issue Exclusions.
Nine Alert and Incident references were rewritten to Issue and Case wording.
Six Alert and Incident references were rewritten to Issue and Case wording.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-se: Split into capabilities, prerequisites, limitations and profiles sections; the Bluetooth limitations now name Cortex XSIAM rather than Cortex XDR.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/xql-query-m: Two collapsible blocks became ordinary headings, and a misspelled Prequisite heading was dropped.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/multi-tenan: The default-encryption and BYOK collapsibles were flattened into bullets under the BYOK step.
items.xsiam/cloud-security/cortex-cloud-identi: The stub gained a thirteen-entry index of its child pages.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-dl: The stub gained two paragraphs on what Endpoint DLP does plus a six-entry index of its child pages.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/remote-repo: The stub gained a four-entry index of its child pages.
Rewritten throughout; the push and pull tenant roles and the list of content that cannot be pushed are restated more directly.
items.xsiam/cloud-security/cortex-cloud-ai-sec: The SaaS app table was reflowed and its description rewritten; the list of supported applications is unchanged.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-dl: Section headings gained the Cortex XSIAM name and the Note headings were stripped from four inline callouts.
items..meta/xsiam: Nine navigation titles changed, including Issue fields to Manage Cortex XSIAM issue fields; no page path moved.
